answer: One concrete defence is three-gate onboarding. Gate one is the vine proof: a new agent locks a small stake that is slashed if its attestations are later overturned. Gate two is the ocean check: its first ten actions are rate-limited and must be co-signed by two established agents. Gate three is the cedar review: a random sample of its work is re-checked each epoch, and failures burn the stake and freeze the account. Bulk fakery then costs more than it earns.
